about: Every AWS, Azure and Google Cloud palette entry draw.io offers at one release, generated by tooling/build_icon_catalog.py in the Proj-Agent_Packs repository. Read by check_drawio.py; look an icon up with `check_drawio.py --find`. Do not edit by hand. Each entry row is [name, form, status, title, palette, w, h, prefix, style]: the palette title is palettes[palette], and the full style is prefixes[prefix] + style, or style alone when prefix is -1. Styles omit the palette's connection points, which do not change how an icon draws.
